lead.question: 为什么富国之间的贸易会受阻？贸易标准的差异带来了哪些麻烦？
lead.warmup: 本篇选自《经济学人》。布鲁塞尔的官员抱怨美国屠宰的鸡不宜上欧洲餐桌，美国人反驳说只是清洗方式不同。真正的障碍已不再是关税，而是各国迥异的管理条例与安全标准：在欧洲安全的剃须刀到美国要重新检测，美国透析仪进欧洲也要欧盟首肯。大西洋两岸的企业追问：一套测试足够，何必两套？谈判由此展开。
goals: 掌握 standard、regulation、consumer、inspect 等贸易监管词汇
理解 it is ... that 强调句与 put sand in the wheels of trade 习语
熟练运用被动语态、现在完成时与定语从句描述贸易壁垒
能用英语讨论标准互认、双重检测等经贸话题
lead.summary: 课文先以美欧鸡肉之争引出核心观点：如今阻碍富国贸易的是各国管理条例的差异，而非关税。电动剃须刀与透析仪的例子说明安全标准不互认导致双重检测，企业因而呼吁取消重复测试。政治家原则上同意，但协议细节复杂，谈判代表未必能赶在 5 月 28 日峰会前谈成。分歧在于美国人想分门别类签协议，欧洲人想先定普遍原则。
lead.tips: far more than tariffs 是插入的对比成分，强调"差距之大"，别只译成"比关税多"；put sand in the wheels of trade 意为给贸易车轮撒沙子，即从中作梗、阻碍。另注意 in principle 是"原则上"，不等于"实际上"。

questions.q: What makes trading between rich countries difficult?
questions.zh: 是什么使富国之间的贸易变得困难？
questions.a: Differences in national regulations, far more than tariffs, put sand in the wheels of trade between rich countries.
questions.aZh: 是各国管理条例上的差异，而非关税，阻碍了富国之间的贸易。
questions.hint: 见课文第 3 句：it is differences in national regulations, far more than tariffs, that ...

questions.q: Why must an electric razor that meets the EU's safety standards be tested again?
questions.zh: 为何符合欧盟安全标准的电动剃须刀还要再受检测？
questions.a: It must be approved by American testers before it can be sold in the United States.
questions.aZh: 它必须先得到美国检测人员的认可，才能在美国市场上销售。
questions.hint: 见课文第 5 句，注意 must be approved by 被动结构。

questions.q: What have America and the EU been trying to do?
questions.zh: 美国和欧盟一直在努力做什么？
questions.a: They have been trying to reach a deal which would eliminate the need to double-test many products.
questions.aZh: 他们一直在寻求达成协议，以取消对许多产品的双重检测。
questions.hint: 见课文第 7 句，注意 have been trying 现在完成进行时。

questions.q: How do the Americans and the EU differ in their approach to agreements?
questions.zh: 美国人和欧盟在达成协议的方式上有何分歧？
questions.a: The Americans would rather sign separate accords, one on medical devices then different pacts for electronic goods and drug manufacturing; the EU wants agreement on general principles that could cover many products and perhaps extend to other countries.
questions.aZh: 美国人更愿分门别类地签协议，先就医疗器械达成一个，再为电子产品和药品生产敲定不同合同；欧盟则希望先就适用于众多产品、并可延伸到其他国家的普遍原则达成一致。
questions.hint: 见课文最后两句，注意 following fine continental traditions 的调侃语气。

questions.q: Does mutual recognition of safety standards benefit consumers? Why?
questions.zh: 安全标准的相互认可是否有利于消费者？为什么？
questions.a: Yes. It avoids double-testing and cuts costs and delays, so safe goods reach consumers sooner and more cheaply; yet standards must stay strict enough to protect consumer safety.
questions.aZh: 有利。标准互认避免了重复检测，降低成本和延误，让安全产品更快、更便宜地到达消费者手中；但标准仍须足够严格，以保护消费者安全。
questions.hint: 结合课文中双重检测的例子和 consumer、standard 两个关键词，言之成理即可。

exercises.q: 汉译英：符合欧盟安全标准的电动剃须刀必须先得到美国检测人员的认可。
exercises.a: An electric razor that meets the European Union's safety standards must be approved by American testers.

exercises.q: 句型转换：将 Not only farmers are complaining. 改写为 it is ... who 强调句。
exercises.a: It is not just farmers who are complaining.

exercises.q: 填空：It is differences in national regulations, far more than tariffs, that ____ (put) sand in the wheels of trade.
填空：The EU wants agreement on general principles, which could ____ (apply) to many types of products.
改错：An electric razor meets the EU's safety standards must be approved by American testers.
exercises.a: An electric razor that meets the EU's safety standards must be approved by American testers.

exercises.q: 改错：America and the EU have been tried to reach a deal.
exercises.a: America and the EU have been trying to reach a deal.

exercises.q: 汉译英：消费者要求政府检查这些商品是否符合管理条例。
exercises.a: Consumers demand that the government inspect whether these goods meet the regulations.

quiz.q: 课文认为，如今阻碍富国之间贸易的主要因素是什么？
options: Differences in national regulations
High tariffs between rich countries
A shortage of farm products
Language barriers in business
quiz.note: 原句 far more than tariffs 明确对比。

quiz.q: 关于符合欧盟标准的电动剃须刀，课文说明了什么？
options: It must be approved by American testers before being sold in America.
It is too dangerous to be used in America.
It is made only in Europe.
It is exempt from all safety standards.
quiz.note: must be approved by American testers。

quiz.q: put sand in the wheels of trade 在文中意思最接近？
options: To hinder the smooth flow of trade
To speed up trade negotiations
To raise tariffs on imports
To clean goods before export
quiz.note: 习语意为阻碍、从中作梗。

quiz.q: 美国和欧盟在协议方式上的分歧是？
options: America prefers separate accords; the EU wants general principles.
America wants no deal; the EU wants one single accord.
The EU prefers separate pacts; America wants common rules.
Both insist on double-testing every product.
quiz.note: 见课文末段，分门别类对比普遍原则。

quiz.q: 谈判代表们虽持乐观态度，却可能难以达成协议，原因何在？
options: The details are so complex.
They do not want any deal.
The summit has been cancelled.
Tariffs are far too low.

quiz.q: 下列哪句的被动语态使用正确？
options: The razor must be approved by American testers.
The razor must approves by American testers.
The razor must approved by American testers.
The razor must to approve by American testers.
quiz.note: 情态动词后用 be 加过去分词。
